pages.text: A seasoned dark magus always hoards a multitude of materials, yet carrying them all is far too cumbersome, and retrieving from a distant warehouse is an ordeal. The Ender Chest gave you inspiration — now you may access your stores from afar.$(br2)Simply write your name in the address bar, and the items shall be delivered straight to your side.$(br)$(4)"Loot to your heart's content — the backpack shall no longer be a shackle."$()
